<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
# Find current green block positions
greens = []
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        greens.append((center_r, center_c))
        print(f"Green at: row {center_r}, col {center_c}")

# Collect all remaining
for r, c in greens:
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    green_count = sum(1 for n in seg if n['color'] == 'N')
    print(f"Click ({r},{c}): Green={green_count}, Game over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
